name: Ugai Sayuki
source:
A detective from East Shinjuku's Detective Department Section 4 who's lost any shred of morals or sense of duty.

With her propensity for violence and ravenous sexual appetite, it's no surprise she's in the pocket of the Aoike Gathering who rule Kabukicho's underbelly.

[From Shiravune, via [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1433]MangaGamer[/url]]
